title: TimelineItem
description: Canonical timeline item aligned with Timeline Truth. id is the preferred drift key; start/end are the planned or actual date range; deterministic evidence fields (date_derivation, evidence_grade, evidence_reason, exact_date_needed) are computed and preserved; source_refs are canonical SourceRef objects.

id.description: Stable item identifier used for drift matching between baseline and current plans.

title.description: Short human-readable item title. Empty titles normalize to "Untitled" and are flagged.

start.description: Planned or actual start date, YYYY-MM-DD.

end.description: Planned or actual end date, YYYY-MM-DD.

time_window.description: Preserved fuzzy window (for example "W3-W4 May 2026") that needs an exact date.

date_text.description: Raw date evidence text, including rejected timezone-free datetimes.

exact_date_needed.description: True when only a fuzzy time window exists.

status.description: Status such as planned, active, done, blocked, at risk.

date_derivation.description: How the date evidence was obtained: explicit (YYYY-MM-DD), natural (deterministically converted natural language), or none.

evidence_grade.description: Deterministic evidence grade computed from the normalized evidence.

evidence_reason.description: Deterministic human-readable reason for the evidence grade.

missing_title.description: True when the source supplied no title.

dangerous_fields.description: Unsupported dangerous fields (prototype pollution vectors, code-execution hints) that were dropped and reported.

source_refs.description: Evidence pointers back to source material.
